text:
alex: Heads up — customer on Dedicated called out that their audit NDJSON export does not include a stable actor identifier for policy changes (only `actor.name`). Can we decide whether to include an `actor_id` or a pseudonym? cc @maya @sam

maya: Is this limited to cross-tenant/replicated changes or visible for normal tenant exports too?

alex: Repro steps: Console -> Compliance -> Export -> choose timeframe -> download NDJSON. Sample payload shows `actor: {name: \"Team Bot\"}` with no id. Seen for service accounts and external-sso actors.

sam: We have code that strips tenant-bound ids in some export flows for privacy. Are they asking for a stable identifier for e-discovery/legal hold?

kevin: Yes, enterprise legal team needs a stable, non-ambiguous id to tie evidence across exports. Raw internal IDs are sensitive. Proposal: include `actor_pseudonym` (hashed) plus `actor_type`.

maya: Pseudonym seems reasonable. Implementation sketch: add `actor_pseudonym` = sha256(tenant_id + ":" + actor_id) and `actor_type` enum (user, service, external). That preserves linkability without exposing raw ids. Also need telemetry: how many exports request full vs sampled?

alex: Note perf/quotas: exports are already rate-limited and adding fields increases payload size. We should estimate S3 download cost and per-request prep time. Also think about canary rollout in the Console.

sam: API shape example (additive, non-breaking):

```json
{"event_id":"e1","actor":{"name":"svc-account-1","pseudonym":"sha256:abcd...","type":"service"},"change":"policy.update","diff":"..."}
```

sam: I'll also emit a tracing span for `prepare_export` and tag `export_mode=full|sample`.

kevin: How should this be gated? Default on for enterprise-paid tenants? Legal prefers opt-in, but product leans to enable by default for enterprise contracts. Maybe config key `export_settings.actor_pseudonym_enabled` per tenant. Console toggle behind a warning and audit trail.

maya: Agree to tenant-level toggle. UX: Compliance settings -> Export preferences -> [ ] Include actor pseudonyms (tooltip: hashed stable id for e-discovery). Default OFF for orgs without contract, ON for enterprise. Add help copy and link to data retention docs.

alex: Telemetry we need: `export.actor_pseudonym_enabled{tenant}`, `export.size_bytes`, `export.prepare_duration_ms`, `export.mode`. Also log pruned fields in case redaction kicks in. Sam, can you add metrics + span?

sam: Yep, will add metrics + span. I'll also add a short log line when pseudonyms are generated: `export:actor_pseudonym=sha256:...` (obfuscated in logs).

kevin: Rollout plan: backend adds field (safe), console toggle behind feature-flag. Canary to 5 enterprise tenants for 48h, monitor export.prepare_duration and support tickets. If no issues, 2-week ramp.

alex: Security/legal check needed before GA. @security-bot can you do a quick review on leakage risk and hashing scheme?

security-bot: I'll triage. Quick notes: sha256 with tenant salt is OK; avoid deterministic cross-tenant correlation. Use per-tenant secret + rotate strategy and document retention.

maya: Notes about historical exports: we cannot retroactively add pseudonyms to already-generated files. Document that and add migration guidance for customers (re-run exports if needed).

alex: Action items: sam implement API change + telemetry (ETA 3d). maya implement console toggle + copy + FF (ETA 5d). kevin coordinate enterprise opt-in list & rollout. I'll draft RFC and sample NDJSON. Security to review within 48h.

kevin: No objections.

sam: On it, will open PR and ping for review.

maya: I'll add docs and changelog entry when PR is merged.

alex: Thanks everyone — I'll create the RFC and add this to the release checklist for the next minor.
